A little clarity

A few things
you might wonder.

Let’s make choosing your next classroom resource feel a little simpler.

Ask me a question
Where do I buy HoneyHearted resources?

The website is designed to help you explore a resource, then continue to its Teachers Pay Teachers listing. Paid purchases and downloads stay on TPT. This preview does not accept payments; the exact store and listing links still need to be connected.

Are the resources printable, digital, or both?

The format depends on the product. The Beachside preview shows PDF, PowerPoint, and Google Slides options. Check the final listing for exact files, editing options, required software, and printing information. The catalog’s format tags are a starting point, not a substitute for the listing details.

Can I see what’s inside before choosing?

Yes. Open a resource to see its detail page and preview gallery. Existing product previews are identified, and illustrative covers are labeled. You can enlarge the actual preview artwork. Final product screenshots should replace any concept covers before launch.

Do I need to subscribe to get the free planning page?

No. The Little Weekly Reset is available directly on this website as a printable HTML file. The email list is optional. The Beachside sample is separate and needs its approved free-download or TPT link connected.

Can I share a purchased resource with my team?

Review the license in the specific product’s listing and included files. Do not assume a purchase includes permission to redistribute it or use it across a whole team. Ask the seller about the right license for your situation.

What should I do about an error or file issue?

Send the resource title, the page or slide involved, and a description of the issue. Please leave out student information and passwords. For an order or payment issue on TPT, use the support options for that purchase.
